intro: Lesson 85: Spelling check: Year 2 Summer 1 spelling patterns. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: How the check works
points: I say the word, then a sentence
We check together at the end

parts.text: Check the rule: -ful has one l

keywords.def: a short test that shows what we know
letters added to the end of a word
words that sound the same but have different meanings

questions.q: Core: spelling check part 1: enjoyment, kindness, careful, helpless, slowly
Extend: part 2: happiness, beautiful, happily, there, two
Stretch: write a sentence with two suffix words
questions.a: For example: The helpful boy walked carefully.
B) beautiful. Change y to i and add -ful with one l: beautiful.
